The included ReadMe workbook is the original OECD 2025 regular ICIO description,
retrieved 2026-11-04 from
https://webfs-sti.oecd.org/files/STI-PIE/ICIO/2025/ReadMe_ICIO_small.xlsx.
SHA-256: `dec015b4d89190607fac90710352c9076d0c58ddfcdf6abf1fb6703d6cfca1ba`.

Citation: OECD (2025), OECD Inter-Country Input-Output Tables, https://oe.cd/icio.
The World Bank identifies the OECD data as CC BY 4.0 at
https://reproducibility.worldbank.org/catalog/511. Other materials in its
replication package have separate licences; those materials are not included here.

The full original 2022 matrix is tested when `TEST_ICIO_PACKAGE` points to the
unmodified `RR_WLD_2026_593.zip`. The application verifies both the package hash
and the original matrix hash recorded in the replication package's own ledger.
It is retained in private evidence, rather than adding a 55 MB package to Git.
